# Input group

An input with addons inside its border: icons, text, buttons.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Dense data</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Dense data:** Search with an icon and a clear button.

- **Use it when:** A search with an icon and a clear button, a value with a unit or currency.
- **Not when:** Controls that are separate fields (lay them out with field).

Instead:

- [Input](./input.md): A plain field.

## Why it works this way

Input group looks the way it does because of 3 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Input group, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-iconography-roles"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What do icons do?</b><code>iconography.roles</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Actions and status</div><p>Icons mark row actions and status.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-start</b>: The search icon before the text.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: icon</code> <code>Empty: icon</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Input group decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-tasks-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How often do people repeat actions?</b><code>tasks.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Constantly</div><p>The same actions repeat many times an hour.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-end</b>: The clear button after the text, for searches people repeat all day.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: ghost</code> <code>Sidebar: default</code> <code>Alert: default</code> <code>Toast: success</code> <code>Toggle: default</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Input group decisions would reopen</small><p>and 11 answers that follow from it: <b>Time on task</b>, <b>All day</b>, <b>Three</b>, and 8 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-content-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How much is on one screen?</b><code>content.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">A lot</div><p>Experts want many records on one screen.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-start</b>: Inputs stay one line high in toolbars and filter bars.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-end</b>: Inputs stay one line high in toolbars and filter bars.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: default</code> <code>Button: compact</code> <code>Button: large</code> <code>Field: horizontal</code> <code>Sidebar: lg</code> <code>Toggle: default</code> <code>Toggle: sm</code> <code>Toggle: lg</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Input group decisions would reopen</small><p>and 14 answers that follow from it: <b>Quiet</b>, <b>Only the steps the screens need</b>, <b>Small</b>, and 11 more.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Lead with the object, then the state: "Alert 2041 contained."
- Use numbers, not words for numbers.
- One verb per button. No "please", no exclamation marks.
- Use: Investigate, Filter, Assign, Escalated, Resolved. Avoid: Oops, Awesome, Please, Simply.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Retry
- `content.action.empty-action`: Change filters

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] Addon buttons have names; icons that only decorate are hidden from screen readers. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add input-group
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Input group reads 37 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Input group's tokens to change Input group alone.
